_notes.refused_on_the_sheets: text inside the picture: objects bw/toothpaste ('Toothpaste'), objects bw/bottle ('Water'), food bw 3/milk ('MILK'), education bw/letter (scribbled lines), beach bw/compass (N E S W), travel and holiday bw/taxi + vehicles bw 2/taxi ('TAXI'), sports bw/eight_ball (an 8); reads as something else: food bw 2/egg (reads as an avocado), valentine bw/heart (two hearts), farm animals bw/pigeon (reads as a chick), sea life bw 2/squid (reads as an octopus: used only where the part is named 'tentacles'), birds bw 2/bird_2 (reads as a dodo), classroom bw/stamp (a rubber stamp no 5-year-old names).
_notes.K-430: vector shapes only (face rule): every copy is DRAWN geometry, cast is empty by design; the shape list per copy is in 'drawn'.
_notes.K-429: the tree, baubles, stars, gifts, window and rug are drawn as on the published page; library cast is the props around it.

honesty.G1-430: Only 13 usable nouns have a word of <= 5 letters in all 11 locales (cat is the published card). Four L1 sets are strict <= 5; the fifth L1 set (ptx-G1-430-cottage) reaches 6 letters (Coruja, Árvore, Uggla, Pöllö) — flagged. L3 'Barnyard' has 3-letter words in sv/da/no/pt (Får, Sau, Get, Ged, Coq) below the pedagogue's 4-letter floor — flagged; every other L3 set holds 4-7 in all 11 locales with >= 2 English digraphs/double letters. Word lengths were checked against REFERENCE TRANSLATIONS/image-vocabulary.js x 11 (script run 2026-10-22).
honesty.G1-432: The library holds ~55 truly symmetric drawings (symmetry.json max <= 10) and almost all are OBJECTS; there is no animal at <= 8 px except the ladybug, the teddy (published) and the butterflies. So the other-half set is mostly objects, every picture is used once across the 15 copies (no reuse), no picture above max 10 px. Koala (faces bw, 9.3) is used once as a BOOK hero where its ears have room (it was refused inside a 165-px window on the published page). L3 'inner details' are drawers, doors, columns, wing veins, buttons — not always eyes.
